criteria.H1: Treated-zone landlord quotes (renewal_offer + price_vacant), M13-M24, y = (new-cur)/cur on [1, is_P, zone_vacancy_smooth]; seed-clustered SE (CR1), CI uses t(G-1). SUPPORTED if b_P > 0 and the 95% CI excludes 0. Also reported: per-seed b_P signs (k of G > 0) and P-S treated rent index at M24 (auxiliary, paired over seeds).
criteria.H2: Treated-zone move-ins M13-M24: P-S difference in mean income and in mean pre-move cash, seed bootstrap (resample seeds, 2,000 draws, fixed RNG). SUPPORTED if both differences > 0 with CIs excluding 0; DIRECTIONAL if both point estimates > 0 only. Low power (~90 move-ins per scenario over 5 seeds) is stated.
criteria.H3: N scenario, L vs R baseline: (a) share of renewal quotes with no hike (<= +0.05%) when zone vacancy < 4%; (b) counter-offer accept rate. OVER-CONCESSIVE if (a) or (b) exceeds R by > 20 pp, or (b) > 98%. Either result is reported.
criteria.quality: Each run: fallback rate < 2%, otherwise the run is void and must be rerun before analysis.
criteria.B: L-N minus R-N, month 36, same seeds: rent_index_all, rent_index_treated, vacancy_all, commute_all. If |mean rent-index gap| > 3 points, every P-S conclusion carries a bias caveat.
criteria.crosscheck: One paired seed run with a cloud model: H1 b_P sign vs the local model on the SAME seed. ROBUST if same sign, MODEL-DEPENDENT if opposite (reported as such); pooled local b_P also shown.
